title: A small search uncovers something larger
literal_meaning: While digging for tubers, Mahadeva appeared.
explanation: An ordinary investigation unexpectedly brings a much larger matter to light. This explanation follows the contrast in scale; the dictionary does not provide an origin tale.
meaning_odia: ସାଧାରଣ କିଛି ଖୋଜୁ ଖୋଜୁ ଅପ୍ରତ୍ୟାଶିତ ଭାବେ ବଡ଼ କଥା ବାହାରି ପଡ଼ିବା। ଛୋଟ ଖୋଜାରୁ ବଡ଼ ଆବିଷ୍କାର—ଏହି ବିପରୀତତାରେ କଥାଟିର ମଜା।
usage_example: Checking one unexplained receipt reveals a much larger error in the accounts. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source labels it ଢଗ under appearing or becoming visible. Mahadeva is Shiva; no particular excavated shrine, village or historical discovery is verified.

witnesses.note: Exact source wording; interpretation and example original editorial work.
